'''2007 Australian Championship Adam Radic DS Ralltiir Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Adam Radic]] at [[2007 Australian Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Ralltiir Operations / In The Hands Of The Empire|SE-D-ralltiiroperations.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Welcome To The Jungle
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
